paper_title: A Search for Hidden Sector Photons with ADMX
notes: ADMX paraphoton (hidden-sector photon) search using an emitter cavity driven at 722.725 MHz and a separate ADMX detector cavity; a light-shining-through-walls-type laboratory search, NOT a dark-matter search, so the limit does not depend on the local DM density (dm_density_assumed=null). Headline 95% CL limit: chi > 3.48e-8 for masses near 3 ueV (abstract, text, Fig. 4). Curve extracted as figure_vector from the black (dark-shaded) ADMX exclusion region in the e-print ROOT EPS figure paraphoton_total_limit.eps (paper Fig. 4). Axis calibration from major tick strokes: x (mass) 622 px/decade with 10^-6 eV at x=797; y (chi) 244 px/decade with 10^-9 at y=467; the polygon tip reproduces m=2.99 ueV, chi=3.48e-8, matching the quoted value. The reported curve is the lower/left boundary of the excluded region (single-valued and monotonic in mass); the vertical right edge at m=3 ueV (mass cutoff at m<omega) and the top-frame edge are not reported as curve points. The excluded region shows a genuine secondary lobe near m=2.2-2.5 ueV (chi dips to ~3.3e-7 then peaks ~8.7e-7) arising from the |G(k/omega)| interference coefficient of Eq. 4 / Fig. 1; this real structure is retained. The plotted curve exits the top of the frame at m~6e-7 eV, chi~1.4e-5. The dashed 'ADMX projected sensitivity' line (chi~1e-9) is a forecast and is excluded from the reported limit. coupling_type=DarkPhoton, reporting chi (not chi^2) per Eq. 1 L = -(chi/2) F B.
